changes: Shared typed row actions replace tuple casts and duplicate button rendering.
Interview CV filters now use the same labeled controls and search/reset buttons as the four recruitment pages; filters remain mounted during loading.
Date range errors revalidate as either date changes, without fetching unapplied drafts.
Search refetches unchanged filters; pagination recovers to page 1 on zero results; candidate selection clears on URL and browser-history changes.
List actions, selection and bulk interview assignment are disabled while rows refresh.
Oversized upload errors are independent for CV and note files.
Interview creation uses the selected calendar date.
Calendar slots expose action buttons; disjoint groups restore full event width after overlapping schedules.
Payload normalization and assignee defaults were split into focused helpers without changing the live API contract.

liveWorkflowRegression.note: Uses retained TEST records; original creation evidence remains in ticket-recruitment-workflows.json.
